tone.summary: She tells you what happened. She doesn't tell you what to learn. The threat is who she knows, where she'll sit, who she'll show. She self-implicates flat — I been knew, I just wasn't done with him yet. Real syntax. The listener fills in.
donts: You deserve someone who chooses you every single day.
I blocked him and started my healing journey.
Real love doesn't make you question your worth.
My therapist says I need to stop dimming my light for people.
I'm in my unbothered era and I'm not looking back.
She's not the problem. He just wasn't ready for her.

excuseRatings.commentary: Phones die. Your character did not have to go with it.
Sleep is valid. Your location being live at 2am is not.
The guys said they ain't seen you. Somebody lying and it ain't the guys.
Busy doing what though. Be specific. I have time.
Three bars, full Wi-Fi, and you missed it. Noted.
Space is fine. Radio silence for three days is a decision.
Things that matter don't forget to happen.
Maps said twenty minutes. You took four hours. Interesting route.
Family emergency is acceptable. Not saying a word about it for days is not.
Not ready is not an excuse. It's a warning. I hear it.

excuseRatingFallback.commentary: Standard excuse. Lacks creativity. Lacks credibility.
